name: Fruits-360 (original size)
original_source: Mihai Oltean / Horea Muresan (rotating-motor webcam videos)
n_original_images: unknown (few hundred physical fruits; one video per class)
ripeness_labels: partial: class names only (e.g. 'Avocado ripe', 'Tomato not Ripened')
known_restrictions: Share-alike: legal review needed on whether trained weights are Adapted Material. Must not relicense redistributed images.
duplication_notes: Same videos as fruits360_100 (use only ONE of the two). Frames of a rotating fruit => extreme near-duplication within class; official test split is from similar videos => leaky
capture_conditions: White paper background, studio light, single fruit, background removed by flood-fill
quality: high image quality / very low diversity
suitability: produce-ID auxiliary training only; never used for evaluation
license_evidence: LICENSE file in cloned repo (CC BY-SA 4.0), git commit in data/raw/fruits360_original/.provenance.json; README fetched 2026-09-26
